translations.web: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
translations.bsb: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
translations.kjv: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
